documentsNeeded: Valid New Zealand passport
notes: Special Category visa (subclass 444): granted automatically on arrival at no cost under the Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement, no advance application needed. It has no fixed day-cap — Home Affairs describes the stay as lasting “from the time you are granted the visa until you leave Australia”, for as long as the holder remains a New Zealand citizen; it ceases on departure and a new SCV is granted on each re-entry. stayPolicy uses the non-computable placeholder because no numeric maxDays exists for this visa (same pattern used for Kenya's eTA), not because a visa application is required in advance.
